div.aria-label: Azure VM profile: users reach cp1/cp2 VMs in two zones through Azure Load Balancer; engines use PG Flexible Server; agents in VMSS run task hosts that upload to Azure Blob and load services under test.

header.p: Same binaries and OS services as bare metal. Azure supplies the load balancer, availability zones, managed identity and, optionally, PG Flexible Server, Blob and Key Vault.
